subject: Vendr: mini onboarding sprint for portal access & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Ella Chen <ella@brightleaf.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brightleaf.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal access request + compressed evidence bundle

Hi Logan / Redwood team,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. We want to get Brightleaf provisioned in Vendr so we can attach our SIG/CAIQ artifacts and a short SOC 2 summary. Goal: surface the key controls for the procurement and finish the last acceptance gate this week.

Two asks to start:
- Please create a temporary read-only service account (or a short-lived SSO link) with upload permission for a single evidence bundle. We'll only upload a structured zip with a CAIQ, SIG spreadsheet, and a SOC 2 summary.
- If you can share a minimal onboarding checklist or preferred filenames/paths, we'll mirror that to keep the portal tidy.

We're aiming to hand off everything in a 72-hour mini-sprint. Attaching a quick index (Brightleaf_profile_index.csv) and a compressed package stub for the portal team to validate expected fields.

Attachments: Brightleaf_profile_index.csv (stub), Brightleaf_Security_Package_stub.zip (contents: SIG.xlsx, CAIQ.json, SOC2_summary.pdf)

Thanks,
Ella Chen
Head of Compliance
Brightleaf Analytics
ella@brightleaf.com
(attachment: Brightleaf_profile_index.csv - 5KB)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ella Chen <ella@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access request + compressed evidence bundle

Hi Ella — thanks for the clear ask and the index. Looping in Mina (security) and Karthik (partner ops) to coordinate the access and evidence mapping. Quick plan below:

1) Access. Mina — can we provision a short-lived, read-only service account scoped to a single request in Vendr? If SSO only, we'll provide SAML metadata.
2) File naming. We prefer the following top-level structure in the zip: /sig/SIG.xlsx, /caiq/CAIQ.json, /soc2/SOC2_summary.pdf. If Brightleaf can name them that way it speeds automatic mapping.
3) Timeline. Ella: once access is available we'll pull the package into our staging (ETA same-day) and mark the request as ready in Vendr.

Attached is our onboarding checklist (short form) for quick crosswalk. If you want, we can accept a delegated S3 ingest (read-only) instead of manual upload — Karthik can coordinate credentials and an expiry window.

Next actions: Mina to confirm access method; Karthik to propose S3 details if that's preferred; Ella to confirm final filename set.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
(attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf - 12KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ella Chen <ella@brightleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access request + compressed evidence bundle

Hi team — quick security note and proposed defaults from our side:

- We can provision a scoped, read-only Vendr service account tied to this request for 5 days. That account will only see the specific evidence bucket for Brightleaf and will not have edit/delete privileges.
- If Brightleaf prefers SSO, we accept SAML/Azure AD. Either approach will require an IP allowlist for the ingest process (we'll provide CIDR ranges).
- Required paperwork: a countersigned DPA (we can accept the standard Redwood template) before we enable programmatic ingest.

I'll attach a short SOC 2 summary and the internal mapping doc that Vendr uses to map SIG fields to our evaluation checks — this should help Brightleaf map columns exactly.

Mina Haddad
Staff Security Engineer, Vendor Risk
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
(attachment: SOC2_summary_redwood_2026.pdf - 50KB)

Cc: Ella Chen <ella@brightleaf.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal access request + compressed evidence bundle

Thanks — this timing works. Quick confirmations from Brightleaf:

- We'll accept the Vendr temporary service account approach; please create the account and send credentials or the SSO URL.
- We'll adopt the exact folder/filename structure Mina suggested.
- We'll countersign the DPA today and return via DocuSign link (see related link).
- We'll also push the prepared zip to Vendr within 24 hours of access.

Links: HubSpot deal (for your ops reference) and the DocuSign powerform are above.

I'll attach a stub export listing the files we'll upload. Once the account is live we'll upload and send a confirmation.

Thanks for the quick turn — this mini-sprint will let procurement close the purchase order.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Security Operations Manager
Brightleaf Analytics
liam.oconnor@brightleaf.com
(attachment: brightleaf_upload_index.csv - 3KB)
